title: ADB Trims India's FY27 Growth Forecast to 6.6% Amid Energy Price Concerns
summary: Asian Development Outlook (ADO) raises India inflation forecast sharply to 5.2%.

blocks.content: Asian Development Outlook (ADO) raises India inflation forecast sharply to 5.2%.

items: GDP Revision: India FY27 GDP growth revised to 6.6% (from earlier 6.9%) due to Middle East energy risks.
Inflation Forecast: Inflation forecast raised to 5.2% (from 4.5% projected in April).
